scientific_integrity: Analytical convex-duality proof of an exact formula; 1001 finite floating-point checks are supplementary rather than infinite certification.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three infinite equal-radius cylinders externally tangent to a Euclidean unit ball, with the fixed cyclic conical direction triple 0 <= c < 1; no claim for arbitrary direction triples, finite cylinders, the endpoint of parallel directions, or a classification of all possible optimizers. Historical priority against unindexed alternative parametrizations remains a risk.
title: Exact two-transition packing law for three cylinders with prescribed conical axes
